entry.title: New: Resolution 419 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE FRIENDS OF LILI‘UOKALANI GARDENS TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE GARDEN ENCHANTMENT, A CHRISTMAS IN THE PARK EVENT

Transfers $7,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 419-25 - 12/17/25
